def run_replay(P, R, D, inp, slots_n, window, events):
    sent = [0] * P
    received = [[] for _ in range(P)]
    up_next = [0] * P
    acked = [0] * P
    floor = 0
    buf = {}          # absolute seq q -> [ranks set, sum list]
    pending = {}      # id -> (kind, rank, seq, value)
    next_id = 0
    ev_out = []

    for (ek, a, b) in events:
        created = []
        status = 'ok'
        if ek == 0:                                    # send
            r = a
            q = b
            enabled = False
            if sent[r] <= q:
                lim = sent[r] + window
                if lim > R:
                    lim = R
                if q < lim:
                    enabled = True
            if enabled:
                pending[next_id] = (0, r, q, inp[r][q])
                created.append(next_id)
                next_id += 1
            else:
                status = 'disabled'
        elif ek == 1:                                  # retry
            r = a
            thr = acked[r]
            if buf:
                for q in sorted(buf):
                    ent = buf[q]
                    if q >= thr and len(ent[0]) == P:
                        pending[next_id] = (2, r, q, ent[1])
                        created.append(next_id)
                        next_id += 1
        else:
            pid = a
            pkt = pending.pop(pid, None)
            if pkt is None:
                status = 'missing'
            else:
                k2, r2, s2, v2 = pkt
                if ek == 3:                           # drop
                    pass
                elif ek == 4:                         # duplicate
                    pending[pid] = pkt
                    pending[next_id] = (k2, r2, s2, v2)
                    created.append(next_id)
                    next_id += 1
                else:                                 # deliver
                    if k2 == 0:                       # up
                        q = s2
                        if floor <= q < floor + slots_n:
                            ent = buf.get(q)
                            if ent is None:
                                ranks = set((r2, ))
                                s = list(v2)
                                buf[q] = (ranks, s)
                                full = (P == 1)
                            else:
                                ranks, s = ent
                                if r2 in ranks:
                                    full = False
                                else:
                                    ranks.add(r2)
                                    for i in range(D):
                                        s[i] += v2[i]
                                    full = (len(ranks) == P)
                            k3 = up_next[r2]
                            while True:
                                e3 = buf.get(k3)
                                if e3 is None or r2 not in e3[0]:
                                    break
                                k3 += 1
                            up_next[r2] = k3
                            pending[next_id] = (1, r2, k3, None)
                            created.append(next_id)
                            next_id += 1
                            if full:
                                for rr in range(P):
                                    pending[next_id] = (2, rr, q, s)
                                    created.append(next_id)
                                    next_id += 1
                        else:
                            pending[next_id] = (1, r2, up_next[r2], None)
                            created.append(next_id)
                            next_id += 1
                    elif k2 == 1:                     # uack
                        if sent[r2] < s2:
                            sent[r2] = s2
                    elif k2 == 2:                     # down
                        row = received[r2]
                        if s2 == len(row):
                            row.append(v2)
                        pending[next_id] = (3, r2, len(row), None)
                        created.append(next_id)
                        next_id += 1
                    else:                             # dack
                        if acked[r2] < s2:
                            acked[r2] = s2
                        fl = min(acked)
                        if fl > floor:
                            floor = fl
                            if buf:
                                for q in [q for q in buf if q < floor]:
                                    del buf[q]
        if len(pending) > MAX_PENDING or next_id > MAX_CREATED:
            raise LimitErr()
        ev_out.append({'status': status, 'created': created})

    hosts = []
    for r in range(P):
        hosts.append({'sent': sent[r], 'received': received[r]})
    slot_out = []
    for q in sorted(buf):
        ranks, s = buf[q]
        slot_out.append({'seq': q, 'ranks': sorted(ranks), 'sum': s})
    pk_out = []
    for pid in sorted(pending):
        k2, r2, s2, v2 = pending[pid]
        pk_out.append({'id': pid, 'kind': KIND_NAMES[k2], 'rank': r2,
                       'seq': s2, 'value': v2})
    return {'hosts': hosts, 'floor': floor, 'slots': slot_out,
            'packets': pk_out, 'events': ev_out}
